hooks.command: G="${SUPPORT_GUARD_PATH:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/support_guard.py}"; [ -f "$G" ] || G="${SUPPORT_GUARD_FALLBACK:-/home/user/tonamorph/tools/support_guard.py}"; [ -f "$G" ] || { echo 'support-guard is missing, so Gmail stays closed: clone GregoryDich/tonamorph to /home/user/tonamorph' >&2; exit 2; }; python3 "$G" hook pre; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; exit 2

S="${SUPPORT_GUARD_STATE:-$HOME/.claude/support-guard}"; [ -n "$(ls -A "$S/tainted" 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; G="${SUPPORT_GUARD_PATH:-$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/support_guard.py}"; [ -f "$G" ] || G="${SUPPORT_GUARD_FALLBACK:-/home/user/tonamorph/tools/support_guard.py}"; [ -f "$G" ] || { echo 'support-guard: this session has read external email and the guard is missing; refusing' >&2; exit 2; }; python3 "$G" hook pre; s=$?; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; exit 2
